label: Bible Study
prompt: For he shall give his _____ charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verse: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
note: The devil quoted this verse to Jesus in the wilderness — and conveniently left out a few words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their _____.
verse: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
note: The God who counts the stars in the very next verse also bandages broken hearts.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the sun stood still, and the _____ stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verse: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
note: The sun stood still and the moon stayed — a day so long the Bible cites the book of Jasher as a second witness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will _____ all men unto me.
verse: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
note: John adds that 'lifted up' signified what death he should die — the cross as a magnet for all men.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a _____.
verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
note: 'Draught' (not draft) is a haul of fish. Peter had caught nothing all night — then the nets started breaking.
